items.label: Newlywed
items.text: Newlywed: Cloud nine. Everything glows. The world is generous and you believe it.

items.label: Grieving
items.text: Grieving: Carrying weight. Every word costs something. You write around the shape of what's missing.

items.label: Sleepless
items.text: Sleepless: 3am. Raw. Edges blurring. Clarity comes in flashes between the fog.

items.label: Apex
items.text: Apex: Top of your game. Everything clicks. Bold choices because you can afford them.

items.label: Burnout
items.text: Burnout: Going through motions. Sparks are rare. When one comes, it's blinding.

items.label: Displaced
items.text: Displaced: New city. Everything unfamiliar. You notice what locals have stopped seeing.

items.label: Masking
items.text: Masking: Performing fine. Cracks showing. The surface is immaculate. Underneath, not so much.

items.label: First Day
items.text: First Day: Everything is new. Trying too hard. The enthusiasm is genuine and slightly exhausting.

items.label: Hungover
items.text: Hungover: Too loud. Too bright. Painful clarity. The filter between observation and page is tissue-thin.

items.label: Numb
items.text: Numb: Nothing lands. Flat affect. Then something small breaks through.

items.label: Pent-Up
items.text: Pent-Up: Wound tight. Everything is almost. The fuse is lit but it hasn't gone off yet.

items.label: Mindbroken
items.text: Mindbroken: Past thinking. Past words. The brain checked out and the body stayed.

items.label: The morning after a sleepless night
items.text: the narrator sees everything through the morning after a sleepless night: too bright, slow, and easily irritated

items.label: The first week in a new city
items.text: the narrator sees everything through the first week in a new city: alert, a little lost, noticing what locals ignore

items.label: The day after very good news
items.text: the narrator sees everything through the day after very good news: generous, light, ready to forgive

items.label: Waiting for an answer
items.text: the narrator sees everything through someone waiting for an important answer: distracted, counting time

items.label: Back home after years away
items.text: the narrator sees everything through someone back home after years away: what changed, what did not

items.label: The last day before leaving
items.text: the narrator sees everything through the last day before leaving: everything is being seen for the final time
